title: Permission leaks: a Desk profile grants CRM view-all; a user can set their own manager without permission

panels.caption: HP-03 — API
text: GET /iam/profiles/{Desk Administrator}/permissions contains metadata.records.view_all (profile app = desk).

mahmoud.mmohamedsamy holds CRM Supervisor + Desk Administrator: GET /iam/me/permissions has metadata.records.view_all, and the user opens every CRM lead (10,848), so the CRM hierarchy never applies to them.

panels.caption: HP-05 — API
text: nameb56175 (User profile) does not have iam.personal.reporting_hierarchy; the Personal Reporting Hierarchy page is hidden for them.

PUT /iam/me/profile {reporting_manager_id: <valafo4080>} as nameb56175 -> 200, and GET /iam/users shows the new manager. The admin route PATCH /iam/users/{id}/reporting-manager correctly returns 403 for the same user.
The test set the manager back right away.

panels.caption: Reference (docs)
text: Zoho: only an administrator sets a user's Reports To (Users → user details). Profiles are per product; a Zoho Desk profile does not change Zoho CRM data sharing.

rows.b: Desk profile affects CRM record access
User without permission changes own manager
